kind.value: Writing and scheduling workspace for X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon and Substack, with a calendar, X analytics, editorial AI and team collaboration

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: Per social set, which is a collection of accounts for one person or brand with its own drafts, calendar and analytics. Free and Creator cover one set and one user; Business is priced per set for up to 50, with unlimited users

freeOption.value: Free plan: 1 social set, 1 user, 10 posts a month, with agents, API and MCP access included

entryPaid.value: Creator, $99 a year — the page marks it annual billing only, so there is no monthly price

plans.value: Free $0 (1 set, 10 posts a month); Creator $99 a year, annual billing only (1 set, 1,000 posts a month); Business $18 per social set a month billed yearly (up to 50 sets, unlimited users, 1,500 posts a month). There is no monthly billing option and no monthly toggle

networks.value: X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Threads, Mastodon and Substack
networks.note: The help centre's social-sets article lists five of these and does not mention Mastodon.

api.value: A public API on every plan including Free, with higher rate limits on Business

mcp.value: An MCP server on every plan including Free, with setup guides for Claude, ChatGPT, Notion, Claude Code and Cursor, and for any assistant that speaks remote MCP over streamable HTTP

ai.value: Editorial AI: a writing assistant, rewrite and improve, and AI image descriptions. Listed as a Creator addition over Free, with higher included usage on Business

teams.value: Teams, roles and permissions on Business, with unlimited users and up to 50 social sets; Free and Creator are one user each. Roles are read-only, write, write and publish, and admin

3.note: Free plan, if the 3 accounts belong to one person or brand: its 1 social set cross-posts to X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon and Substack, with 10 posts a month. Accounts for more people or brands need more sets, which only Business sells, at $18 a month per set billed yearly. Creator is $99 a year, annual billing only
